description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Lang, which validates language code attributes in HTML according to RFC 3066. The class includes a method validate that processes and verifies language subtags, ensuring they conform to standards.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Lang
classes.description: A class for validating the 'lang' attribute in HTML attributes, ensuring it conforms to language code standards based on RFC 3066.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a language code string, checking syntax and conforming to RFC 3066 rules, returning a normalized language code or false if invalid.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the language code string, verifying subtags and conforming to standards.
